metadata.title: Second Opinion
metadata.description: Get a secure second opinion from expert physicians for your medical imaging.

units.file: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}

about.title: Second Opinion is being designed for a secure second opinion experience.
paragraphs: The platform aims to make the imaging-focused second opinion process between patient, operations team and expert physician simple and controlled.
This prototype includes no claims about real institutions, certifications, success rates or patient volume.

contact.title: Case and support communication stays inside the platform.
paragraphs: In the real service, patient communication should not scatter across personal channels; it should remain case-based and recorded.
This page demonstrates the secure communication approach before a live contact form is connected.

cookies.title: The cookie policy should be written around real analytics and security tools.
paragraphs: This prototype does not publish a real cookie inventory. Before production, a transparent policy should be prepared according to the tools actually used.

help.title: Simple support for upload, application and report delivery.
paragraphs: The help center will explain practical topics such as finding DICOM files, uploading ZIP files, adding supporting documents and accessing reports.
Technical errors and clinical case status are designed to be handled separately.

kvkk.title: The KVKK notice should be prepared around the real operating process.
paragraphs: Because Second Opinion focuses on health data, it should be handled under sensitive personal data principles. This prototype does not publish legal text.

pricing.title: Pricing will be finalized with the real operational model.
paragraphs: This prototype does not publish a payment model or price amount. The system can support payment before submission, payment after physician acceptance, or authorization-capture models.

privacy.title: The privacy policy should be finalized with legal review before production.
paragraphs: This page is placeholder guidance, not a real legal policy. Data processing, retention, sharing and user rights should be defined clearly before launch.

terms.title: Terms of use will be finalized with the production scope.
paragraphs: The real terms should clearly state that the service is not emergency healthcare, define the second opinion scope and explain report delivery conditions.
